scenarios.description: Qualify typed read-only Time consumers through the public gateway.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_TIME_CONSUMERS_INPUT, an installation target, private caller and administrator token files, selected authority/calendar/epoch/source fixtures and a new receipt path. Reads Time through the public gateway; performs no Task, restart or authority activation.

scenarios.description: Qualify selected schedule Task completion, cancellation or externally signalled unfinished recovery through the public gateway.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_TIME_SCHEDULE_TASK_INPUT with explicit complete/cancel/recover mode, a public Gateway profile with official Time Tasks, a private OAuth caller token file, selected current authority/calendar, independent expected output and new private JSONL receipt. Cancel/recover require delivered and current Working. Recover requires one admitted time-mcp Rust container and an external operator signal only after the persisted armed marker; replacement must retain the same unfinished Task. The harness sends no process signal or authority activation. A too-fast schedule fails qualification.

scenarios.description: Qualify retained completed schedule Task reads and initial snapshot delivery through distinct physically fenced backends.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_TIME_SCHEDULE_HANDOFF_INPUT, the original private complete-mode input and successful v2 completion receipt plus its digest, retained opaque Task ID/createdAt, a private normal OAuth caller token and typed A/B setup. Ops alone creates and routes the same-image/config read-only authority-volume replica, scales original A to zero, restores A before the original selector, then retires B. Native Kubernetes watches admit process exit, Pod absence and sole Service endpoints while fresh Gateway reads/listens verify the original independent output. No Task creation, unfinished recovery or post-mutation delivery is qualified.

scenarios.description: Qualify isolated authority acquisition, guarded activation, delivered changes and retained epoch rebinding through the public gateway.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_TIME_AUTHORITY_INPUT: a private fixture selecting a dedicated isolated installation/tenant, verified ordinary reader and administrator OAuth identities, two admitted immutable HTTPS authority products with independent SHA-256 digests/version labels, bootstrap authority and independent epoch/UTC expectations, and a new private JSONL receipt. Writes retained sources, four acquisition jobs, authority selections and two immutable epoch versions. Uses one 900-second operation deadline; each acquisition permits at most 66 correlated GETs spaced five seconds. No reference authority mutation, reset, process signal or automatic mutation retry. Ops owns retirement of isolated state and unresolved jobs.

scenarios.description: Qualify future event delivery, cancellation, fenced restart and missed-update reconciliation through normal OAuth.

requirements.explanation: Requires VEOVEO_TIME_EVENTS_INPUT with installation, selected current authority and an admitted single Time Pod; normal OAuth same-owner caller needs current profile-required scopes plus time:read/time:event:write. Arms time://events before creating four retained events, performs one UID/RV-fenced process rollout, and reconnects explicitly. Original300-second operation plus30-second cleanup; no Task dispatch or authority mutation. Ops owns isolated retained-state retirement.
